# End of startup stage Usr3

The call that ends the startup task Usr3; fenykl's loader patch replaces it with a call to its stub.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x6018d73a` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

Runs once per boot on CPU0, after Usr3 decided whether to post the card mount. The OK-held card update does not reach this point, so a loader here cannot block reflashing. The stub starts the loader task and then ends Usr3 as the stock call did.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The 7-byte edit and the digest of the stock bytes it replaces are pinned in the patch. Source: [fenykl loader patch for E-M10 Mark II 1.4](../sources/fenykl.loader-patch.md).
- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Usr3 lowers itself to priority 65, so it reaches this call only after Usr1 has ended; an OK-held update boot never reaches the end of Usr1. Source: [fenykl loader source for E-M10 Mark II 1.4](../sources/fenykl.loader-source.md).
- **Physical camera** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The patched firmware runs the main plugin on the maintainer's camera. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).
